findings.evidence: The definition at lines 35–44 has codomain `(Ω →ₘ[μ] ℝ) →+ (Ω →ₘ[μ] ℝ)`, while lines 55–67 separately prove preservation of `1` and multiplication and no `map_smul` theorem is exposed; the roadmap at lines 540–545 requires an operator-level positive, unital, multiplicative API.
findings.fix: Bundle precomposition as an `ℝ`-algebra homomorphism (or at least a linear map with the multiplicative/unital structure exposed appropriately), then derive the `one`, `mul`, and scalar-action API from that bundle.
findings.issue: `koopmanMarkov` is exposed only as an `AddMonoidHom`, so consumers cannot use its real-linearity, unitality, or multiplicativity through the bundled interface; those defining Koopman properties remain detached propositions.

summary: The bundled operator omits essential linear and multiplicative structure needed by the advertised Markov/Koopman API.
